title: Citebase tool call
description: Runs one Citebase tool in your Apify account. For private projects, use the encrypted private_request field and read the result from your account's restricted store.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: Which Citebase tool to run, for example 'get_playbook'. Start with get_playbook and arguments {} to list the guidelines, then read 'start'. Required. NOT an Apify Actor name.

project_store_id.title: Existing Citebase project storage
project_store_id.description: Optional. Select your existing project storage if it predates Limited permissions. New projects can leave this blank.

schedule_ledger_id.title: Confirmed schedule allowance queue
schedule_ledger_id.description: Citebase sets this field when you confirm a project schedule. It holds the account's existing check reservations.

schedule_lock_id.title: Confirmed project schedule lock queue
schedule_lock_id.description: Citebase sets this field when you confirm a project schedule. It lets the final check pause its own schedule safely.

private_request.title: Private project request
private_request.description: For project_work, get_history or save_results, put the tool's arguments here and leave regular arguments empty. For example, project_work accepts { "project": "acme-site", "operation": "project_focus" }. Apify encrypts this object. The OUTPUT record contains private_result with the store_id and key to read while signed in. Never include credentials.

private_store_id.title: Existing restricted Citebase project records
private_store_id.description: Optional resource grant for the restricted Citebase private-answers store when this Actor cannot already open the project's saved briefs or records.

revisions_queue_id.title: Existing restricted Citebase revisions
revisions_queue_id.description: Optional resource grant for the restricted Citebase work-revisions queue used for this project's saved versions. Leave blank for new projects.

arguments.title: Tool arguments (JSON)
arguments.description: Inputs for the chosen tool as a JSON object. get_playbook {name?} e.g. {"name":"start"}. audit_site {url?, max_pages?, project?} e.g. {"url":"https://example.com","project":"acme-site"} (project saves the check and shows what changed). quote_cost {pack:"starter"} or {items:[{job,units,requests?}]}. measure_recommendation_share {panel,runs,brand?,...} or {project}. next_steps {project?,audit?,report?,max_steps?}. check_outreach_draft {to,subject,body,...}. check_ai_content {text,threshold?}. save_results {project, runs?, panel?, brand?, audit?, settings?, todo?, server_log?, traffic?, traffic_csv?, gsc_csv?, ranks?, fact_checks?, check_only?}. get_history {project?, answer_review?} (empty lists every saved project). make_report {project, prospect?}. import_ai_results {project, snapshot, dataset_ids?, items?, save?, append?, replace?, panel?, brand?, context?} reads results (pass the finished runs' dataset ids as dataset_ids) of AI Brand Monitor, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode and the tracker Actors (send panel and brand with save true to start a project in one step; context is the country, language and device of the run). schedule_checks {project, url?, frequency?, max_pages?, platforms?, repeats?} gives the Actor runs to add and the worst-case monthly cost; repeats is 1 to 5, default 3. scheduled_check {project, url, max_pages?, ai_import?}: the site check + report refresh to run from an Apify Schedule. No credentials here. Defaults to {}.
